relations.subject: J. A. Schoterman
relations.evidence: I wish to thank my supervisor, Prof, Dr. H. W. Bodewitz, who kindly took the trouble to familiarize himself profoundly with the subject

relations.subject: J. A. Schoterman
relations.evidence: To Dr. T. Goudriaan, who acted 25 co-referent, I am very deeply indebted

relations.subject: M. Witzel
relations.evidence: Dr. M. Witzel has been of indispensable assistance in procuring microfilms of the manuscripts from the National Archives (Kathmandu), when he was stationed in the Valley for the German-Nepal Manuscript Preservation Project.

relations.subject: J. A. Schoterman
relations.evidence: I consider it a matter of personal obligation to express here my feelings of sincere gratitude and admiration towards this scholar: I have always regarded it a rare privilege to have had a guru of such qualities.
